analysis.overall: You had a strong day with 94% time in range and a steady night, though stacked corrections in the afternoon and a mismatched dinner bolus caused brief drops.

events.title: Afternoon peak and quick drop
events.description: Glucose topped out at 194 mg/dL, but a series of small correction boluses combined to send levels down sharply to 72 mg/dL over the next hour.

events.title: Post-dinner low
events.description: Insulin for your 45g carb dinner hit faster than the food absorbed, pulling your glucose down to a daily low of 64 mg/dL.

events.title: Late-night dinner rise
events.description: As the meal carbs finally digested late, glucose drifted up to 161 mg/dL before light corrections brought you back in range.

events.title: Steady overnight line
events.description: Your basal rates held your glucose remarkably flat between 75 and 100 mg/dL straight through until morning.

events.title: Breakfast bump
events.description: A 50g carb breakfast bolus managed the morning well, brief rise up to 169 mg/dL before leveling off cleanly around 110 mg/dL.

analysis.watch_for_tomorrow: Watch out for stacking multiple small correction boluses within an hour, as the combined tail can cause unexpected rapid drops.
